title: Webb Captures Stellar Jets
caption:
NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has pierced through the dust of NGC 7129, a stellar nursery 3,300 light-years away. The new infrared view reveals hidden protostars carving out golden and crimson shockwaves in cosmic gas clouds.

Source: Nasa - Webb Captures Stellar Jets

https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/webb-captures-stellar-jets/
